Generated by CI from `cad/ergodox_case.py`.

| Archive | Contents | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `*-stl.zip` | 4 × STL (left/right, top/bottom), the 2 plate spacers, the leg and its TPU foot cap, plus a preview of the right half with the legs | Slicer: 3D-print a test fit before machining |
| `*-jlccnc-order.zip` | Per part (4 case parts + leg): STEP + PDF manufacturing drawing (threads, detent teeth, tolerances, finish); foot-cap STL; `hole_table.csv`; `ORDER_NOTES.md` | Upload to JLCCNC (or any CNC service); see `ORDER_NOTES.md` |
| `*-step.zip` | 4 × STEP, the plate spacers, the leg, the assembly preview with the legs, and `ergodox_right_fitcheck.dxf` | CAM / CNC shop; print the DXF at 100 % to check your PCB |

Each archive includes `build-report.txt` (screw clearances, part masses, geometry validity).

**Before cutting aluminium**, work through [docs/fit-check.md](REPO_URL/blob/main/docs/fit-check.md).
